name: California Air Resources Board
program: CARB Research Program annual research project solicitation (FY2026-27 pre-proposals closed; recurs yearly)
collect_note: The Research Planning page carries a call-to-action block for each year's research solicitation (title, letter-of-interest date, link to the solicitation landing page); the crawler reads that block and hops to the landing page for the nearest future pre-proposal due date. Next year's block replaces this one at the same address.

sample.title: Funding Year 2026-2027 Solicitation for Pre-Proposals Now Open

evidence: 2026-11-20 channels tried: official API none (Drupal; /jsonapi/node/article returns 503); feeds none (page has only hreflang alternates; CARB mail updates run through govdelivery subscription, not a feed); sitemap.xml has 2 URLs and no research hits; site JSON none; portals: the projects are mirrored on empowerinnovation.net (third-party listing, not used); research-planning/news lists no solicitations; research-planning/resources lists priorities and an unrelated EJ co-development solicitation. Best channel: HTML call-to-action block on research-planning (plain HTTP 200) plus detail hop to the landing page, which lists per-project 'Pre-proposals due by 5pm on <date>' lines.
